summary: Iter-32 — Tested QA/QC inspection feature end-to-end (Concrete Form, Rebar, Subcontractor Work). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_qaqc_inspections_iter32.py covering POST with new fields (mix_design/yards_ordered/concrete_vendor), server-side PM backfill from jobs_master (project_number 25-15 → Chris Wright/chriswright@mascigc.com), admin GET list includes pm_name+pm_email per row, PM-scoped GET /api/pm/qaqc-inspections (empty pm → [], by-email filters correctly, by-name filters, unknown PM → [], requires admin OR PM token), GET single, DELETE, stats endpoint, server-side count recomputation (2 pass / 1 fail / 1 na verified). Frontend: 7/7 UI checks PASS — Admin Hub admin-tile-qaqc renders + nav to /admin/qaqc; PM Hub pm-tile-qaqc renders + nav to /pm/qaqc; /pm/qaqc empty-state requires PM picker (shows ‘Pick your name above to load…’); selecting Chris Wright persists localStorage masci.pm.viewer.email and filters records (search + Kind dropdown render); /qaqc/concrete-form/new shows all 7 critical fields (Mix Design, Yards Ordered, Concrete Vendor combo, Subcontractor combo, Work Area, GPS button, Job picker); /qaqc/rebar/new HIDES Mix/Yards/Concrete-Vendor while keeping Subcontractor combo + GPS + Work Area; /qaqc/subcontractor-work/new shows Work Activity + shared fields and HIDES concrete-only fields. All routes match spec exactly.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Originates from the PM picker dropdown — likely a styled <span> wrapped inside an <option>. Page renders & works but should be cleaned up to avoid hydration error.

action_items: (LOW) Fix the <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning in /app/frontend/src/pages/PmQaqcList.jsx Viewing-as <select>. Use plain text in <option>, or move stylized fragments outside the option element.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side PM backfill in /app/backend/routes/qaqc.py is correctly idempotent: only fills pm_name/pm_email if the payload omitted them; explicit values from the form are preserved (verified by test_pm_explicit_value_not_overwritten).
Server-side count recomputation in POST /qaqc-inspections is trustworthy — pass/fail/na are recomputed regardless of what the client sent (verified 2/1/1 from a 4-item checklist).

GET /api/pm/qaqc-inspections empty-pm short-circuit correctly returns [] instead of leaking all records — important security default since PMs share Happy123! and the endpoint accepts both admin & PM tokens.

_summary_from_doc lowercases pm_email both on read and on insert backfill — consistent normalization. pm_name comparison is case-sensitive (uses exact match {pm_name: pm_q}) which works because backfill always pulls the canonical value from jobs_master.
No Mongo _id leakage: /qaqc-inspections/{id} GET returns clean doc (verified).
